summary_1line: Abhimanyu rebukes Duhsasana for past wrongs, wounds him severely in battle, and the Pandavas rejoice as Kaurava warriors rally to attack the youth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Abhimanyu, bloodied yet smiling in his chariot, releases a blazing arrow that strikes Duhsasana in the shoulder before the watching armies.
Duhsasana collapses unconscious on the terrace of his chariot as his charioteer hurriedly drives him away from the battlefield.
Pandava warriors blow conches and drums and roar with lion-like cries as Abhimanyu stands amid a storm of arrows.
